strongest_angle: James McAvoy reflects on his long-held ambition to direct, detailing the creative challenges and personal motivations behind his debut feature film, California Schemin'.

key_facts.fact: James McAvoy, aged 47, makes his directorial debut with the feature film California Schemin', which opens in theaters in October 2026.
The film California Schemin' is based on the true story of the Scottish rap duo Silibil N' Brains, who adopted fake American personas to find success.
James McAvoy described the process of directing his first feature film as one of the most stressful experiences of his professional career.

numbers.label: Age when McAvoy first considered directing

quotes.text: I've been thinking about directing since I was 16. I should have done it sooner.
